answer_1.quote: We propose a SIGNAL model, in the context of Chinese text spam detection, to address the imbalance, efficiency, and text camouflage problems.
answer_1.outputs: The SIGNAL model generates semantically similar texts through data augmentation using a Semi-supervised Variational AutoEncoder (S-VAE) with masked attention learning and character variation graph-enhanced augmentation to simulate phonetic or glyph variation mutations for Chinese text spam detection.
